SlideMate 0.4.1 brings its own Python, so setting it up never needs Apple's Command Line Tools.

### Fixes
- **No more "not enough disk space" on first launch.** SlideMate used to need Apple's Command Line Tools for Python,
  and their installer can ask for over 17 GB of free space. The app now carries a small Python of its own, so there's
  nothing extra to install. The download is about 20 MB bigger as a result.

### Install
Already on 0.3 or 0.4? SlideMate offers this update by itself (or choose SlideMate → **Check for Updates…**).

New here: download **SlideMate-0.4.1-macOS.zip** below, unzip it, and drag SlideMate into Applications. First open:
macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**; macOS 13–14: right-click → **Open**. The app isn't
notarised yet.

If you were stuck on the Command Line Tools screen: quit SlideMate (cancel Apple's installer), replace it with this
version, and open it again.
